The algorithm should consider the following:  Each magic ability should have a unique name and description  Magic abilities should be categorized by rank, with higher ranks indicating greater power and rarity  Magic abilities should have unique limitations and costs to balance their power  Overpowered magic should be extremely rare and come with significant consequences  The algorithm should be flexible enough to generate a wide variety of magic abilities, while ensuring that they are balanced and consistent within the world of Aethoria.assistant

import random

# Define a list of magic ability categories
categories = ["Elemental", "Arcane", "Divine", "Nature", "Technomancy"]

# Define a list of magic ability ranks
ranks = ["Novice", "Apprentice", "Adept", "Master", "Legend"]

# Define a list of magic ability limitations
limitations = ["Physical toll", "Magical exhaustion", "Unstable energy", "Dependence on specific materials", "Vulnerability to specific elements"]

# Define a list of magic ability costs
costs = ["Mental focus", "Physical stamina", "Magical energy", "Material resources", "Temporal consequences"]

# Define a list of magic ability descriptions
descriptions = [
    "Unleashes a burst of elemental energy",
    "Manipulates the fabric of reality",
    "Channels divine power",
    "Communes with nature",
    "Hacks into technological systems"
]

# Define a list of overpowered magic ability names
overpowered_names = ["The Devourer", "The Architect", "The Oracle", "The Catalyst", "The Omega"]

# Define a list of overpowered magic ability descriptions
overpowered_descriptions = [
    "Consumes all in its path",
    "Rewrites the fundamental laws of reality",
    "Sees into the very fabric of existence",
    "Manipulates the underlying code of the universe",
    "Transcends the boundaries of time and space"
]

def generate_magic_ability():
    # Randomly select a category
    category = random.choice(categories)

    # Randomly select a rank
    rank = random.choice(ranks)

    # Randomly select a limitation
    limitation = random.choice(limitations)

    # Randomly select a cost
    cost = random.choice(costs)

    # Randomly select a description
    description = random.choice(descriptions)

    # If the rank is Legend, randomly select an overpowered name and description
    if rank == "Legend":
        name = random.choice(overpowered_names)
        description = random.choice(overpowered_descriptions)
    else:
        name = f"{category} {rank} Magic"

    # Return the generated magic ability
    return {
        "name": name,
        "description": description,
        "category": category,
        "rank": rank,
        "limitation": limitation,
        "cost": cost
    }

# Generate 10 magic abilities
magic_abilities = [generate_magic_ability() for _ in range(10)]

# Print the generated magic abilities
for ability in magic_abilities:
    print(f"Name: {ability['name']}")
    print(f"Description: {ability['description']}")
    print(f"Category: {ability['category']}")
    print(f"Rank: {ability['rank']}")
    print(f"Limitation: {ability['limitation']}")
    print(f"Cost: {ability['cost']}")
    print()
